newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures up on year-end short covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures up on year-end short covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on year-end book squaring as players covered short positions, while the yen's weaker tone against the dollar also lent support, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 2.4 yen per kg higher, with benchmark June ending up 0.9 at 148.0 yen.
Activity was dull, with thin trade accentuating price movements amid a dearth of large-lot selling, traders said.
"Investors retreated to the sidelines as the market lacks fresh incentives. Further gains could be capped by profit taking," one trader said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk
